requirement: Map a create-antibiogram command to a new Antibiogram model: copy the pathogen ID and MIC category, let the entity generate its ID, and leave the antibiotic join collection empty for the handler to fill.

preconditions.text: The mapper is constructed without dependencies

inputs.text: Command with MIC Susceptible and two antibiotic IDs
Command with MIC Resistant and two antibiotic IDs
Command with MIC Intermediate and one antibiotic ID through the dependency overload

returns.text: Antibiogram with the command pathogen and MIC, a generated ID, and an empty antibiotic collection

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the mapper always returns a successful result
